title: fix: canonicalize and validate API provider mappings
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Uses the Economics vendor catalog to validate canonical IDs across all 219 bundled model routes. Checks every text route against its configured supplier and AWS attribution for Nova Canvas/Reel; other media routes have catalog-membership coverage only.
- Standardizes `bedrock` attribution to `aws` and Economics' `vast.ai` ID to `vast`, preserving historical aliases. After deployment, `/v1/models/status` reports `aws` for affected traffic; overlapping windows can return either label. Model IDs, transports, routes, prices, and account identities stay unchanged.
- Updates forecast, funding, GPU consumers, and the Vast collection guide. Normalizes saved forecast-rule keys when read and rejects alias collisions. September 8 production/staging audits found no affected saved keys; no stored-data migration was needed.
- Intentionally leaves Tinybird's historical `vast.ai` output unchanged: Economics combines aliases. No Tinybird deployment is needed. MCP/Composio onboarding remains separate. Fixes the missing Tinybird mock in an existing Perplexity test.
- Validation: compatibility 427 (including forecast alias checks in CI) and Economics 429 tests, Economics typecheck/build, and Biome pass. Earlier focused Gen 109, Enter aliases 473, and VCR 49 tests passed; VCR has no Claude/Nova snapshots. No deployment or live inference calls; external reporting consumers were not verified.

gist.headline: Provider names find their hive
gist.blurb: The provider ledger got its labels combed. Bedrock traffic now reports as AWS, Vast aliases resolve cleanly, and 219 bundled model routes are checked against the catalog.
gist.summary: Canonicalized provider mappings across all 219 bundled model routes, standardizing Bedrock attribution to `aws` and Economics' `vast.ai` ID to `vast` while preserving historical aliases and validating configured text suppliers.
gist.impact: `/v1/models/status` now reports `aws` for affected Nova Canvas and Nova Reel traffic, while model IDs, routes, transports, prices, and account identities continue unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy provider-routing garden: Polli carefully relabels two sturdy flower pots, one marked AWS and one marked VAST, while neat glowing model-route vines lead into a retro status monitor. The monitor robot can inspect the canonical labels, and small alias tags are safely filed nearby to show compatibility without clutter.
